The prestigious title of 'Umamusume of
the 
Year.' This time,
it was awarded to Narita 
Brian.

Past award recipients also attend the 
ceremony. Talking with seasoned veterans 
seems like it would be a great
experience. 
However, it might still be too early... 
perhaps.

Should she attend in search of encounters 
with strong rivals, or not? This was an 
important choice that would shape her 
future.
